name: Home hub
description: Your lights, locks and sensors from a home hub on your own network: list them over its REST API, and switch a light on or off over its WebSocket API. An example of an http adapter with a private host pinned by its certificate, a WebSocket, and a kept token that Valet sends both as a header and as the socket's sign-in message.

hub.description: A long-lived access token from your hub's profile page

tools.name: list_devices
tools.title: List devices
tools.description: The lights, switches, locks and sensors your hub knows: each one's id, name, state and when it last changed.

tools.name: switch_light
tools.title: Switch a light
tools.description: Turns one light on or off, by its id from list_devices (light.something).
